contract: Section 8.3 counter contract / Section 8.4 telemetry requirements (research/p0-r2-counter-fix)
description: One row per request at the request level, plus a separate event-level table with one row per logical interrupt, transport attempt, provider response, and full-reasoning fallback operation. Event rows join to the request row by request_id_hash. Ingestion MUST deduplicate events by event_id before aggregation (identical replays are replay marks; conflicting payloads carry a conflict flag and never update counters).

request_level_field_semantics.anchor_interrupt_count: runtime-event boundary; incremented once per accepted logical interrupt (Section 8.3)
request_level_field_semantics.anchor_transport_attempt_count: transport boundary; incremented per HTTP/API attempt including retries
request_level_field_semantics.anchor_provider_generation_unknown_reaso: mandatory reason codes: TIMEOUT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN | TRANSPORT_ERROR | PROVIDER_RESPONSE_MALFORMED | BILLING_FEED_MISSING
request_level_field_semantics.anchor_tokens_billed_evidence: CONFIRMED | UNAVAILABLE(BILLING_FEED_MISSING); UNAVAILABLE must not be recorded as zero
request_level_field_semantics.full_oracle_fallback_avoided: tri-state true | false | UNKNOWN; true only when terminal_regime is known FAST_PATH and full_oracle_fallback_count = 0; means full-reasoning fallback was avoided, NOT that all Oracle/Anchor traffic was avoided

event_level_field_semantics.event_type: anchor_interrupt | anchor_transport_attempt | anchor_provider_response | full_oracle_fallback | full_oracle_transport_attempt | full_oracle_provider_response | gate_decision | render_lifecycle
event_level_field_semantics.ingest_replay_mark: true when an identical event_id was ingested before; replays never re-count
event_level_field_semantics.ingest_conflict_flag: true when a duplicate event_id carries a conflicting payload; conflicts are surfaced, never merged

derived_metric_rules: full_oracle_fallback_avoided = true only for a known FAST_PATH terminal regime with full_oracle_fallback_count = 0.
Join request-level and event-level records before computing counts, token totals, cost, or latency distributions; report denominators, missing-data rates, and conflict rates.
Do not equate logical interrupts, transport attempts, provider generations, and token totals.
Do not infer provider billing from client-side attempts alone.
Do not coerce unknown or unavailable evidence to zero.
privacy: Do not record API keys, raw prompts, full responses, or unredacted user identifiers.
